states: All HN leaders are not okay

say: Every one of them is gone. Phoenix, Seta, Valtena and the six Inquisitors. The Nation is a robe with no body in it.
No Phoenix. No Inquisitors. The soldiers stand and wait for orders that will never come.
The Flame has no priest left to keep it. It burns anyway.
I counted nine leaders once. Now I count the empty chairs.

states: All HN leaders are not okay

say: The Nation has no leaders left. Every Inquisitor, every High one, and Phoenix. Someone should write that down.
The whole Holy leadership is dead. I'll believe it when I stop seeing their banners.
A nation is more than its leaders. We'll learn how much more.
The Holy leadership is entirely gone. The Nation will have to learn to walk.

states: All HN leaders are not okay

say: No leaders left. Do not ask me what the Nation intends. It intends nothing at all.
The Flame is orphaned. We still keep it.
Walk on. I have a town to mind and nobody to tell me how.
The Flame has no head. We do our best, and our best is quiet.

states: Border Zone Bandits are not Okay

say: The Border Zone bandits are all dead. Dimak, Buzan, even the Dust King. The roads are quieter than I like.
No Dust King, no Dimak, no Buzan. The border is empty of bosses.
The bandit chiefs on the border are all gone. Strange to travel without that low dread.
No bandit lords on the border. The roads feel odd without them.
Esata, Mukai, Flying Bull, Ghost, Tora. All dead. The Kingdom has no leaders and no mouth.
The Shek leaders are all gone. The Kingdom is a name and a lot of angry warriors.
A Kingdom without its leaders. It will fight itself, or someone else.
Kingdom leaders all fallen. We carry the axes. Nobody carries the Kingdom.
Dhe Gran' Wizard is gone. Dhe bell does not ring in dhe west. Dhe tribes look for a new voice.
No Wizard, no bell. Dhe west is hungry and dhe west is leaderless.
Dhe remnants of dhe west go where dhe pot is hot.
Dhe bell is quiet. Dhe quiet is worse.
Dhe Meat Lord is gone. Dhe table is empty. Dhe east fights over dhe chairs.
No Meat Lord, no manners. Dhe tribes eat like dhey used to.
Dhe east is scattered now. Scattered is hungry.
Dhe dinners get ugly now. Nobody say grace.
Dhe Darkfinger chiefs are all dead. Dhe name is just a name now.
No Darkfinger chiefs. No Meat Lord. Dhe east has nothing but stray teeth.
Dhe old chiefs are gone. We wait for new ones, and dhey do not come.
Darkfinger is a word, not a place. Dhe chiefs are bones.
Flotsam owes you. We don't say that lightly. We say it quietly.
You did right by us. The forest remembers.
A friend of Flotsam. Walk freely. The wood is watching, kindly.
Flotsam doesn't hand out thanks. This is the nearest thing.
You let us down. We won't make a scene.
Flotsam doesn't forget a failure. Neither does it forgive.
You're no friend of ours.
We counted on you. We count now what that cost.
We hear you've taken Flotsam's work. See that you finish it.
The forest has an errand for you. Don't take too long.
Our business is your business now. Don't lose it.
You carry Flotsam's trust. Don't waste it.
The Free Traders will keep their word. They have given it, they say, because of you.
I hear the Free Traders agreed to help. The roads will feel it.
A friend to the Free Traders. That's worth something.
Free Traders don't give their word lightly. They gave it for you.
The Hive agreed to help, they say. Hive and no-hive working together. I'll believe it when I see it.
The Western Hive likes you. That's a rare thing.
Hive words are hard to get. You got them.
The Hive spoke well of you. That's a thing worth holding.
